notes.title: Quality of Life Update!
notes.content:
For those struggling with the trials, fear not! A Quality of Life update is now here. 

[b]Fast Forward to the Action![/b]

If you've searched with all the options before the third round, a Fast Forward option unlocks on the Main Menu that lets you set your previous choices and skip to a certain announcement. Hopefully, this will help those hoping to find all the routes by speeding up the process of trial and error.

[b]Aid to the Lost![/b]

Unsure if you know the answer to a certain puzzle? Forgetting a certain name you learned elsewhere? Have you exhausted all your hints, and yet you can't progress? Fear not! Some helpful additions have been added to smooth over some issues. The game will now remind you of relevant information you may have found, or notify you if you're going down a wrong path. And if you really stumped at certain sections, the option to simply unlock part or all of the answer is now present.

[b]Improvements to the Whole![/b]

Also, in general, a number of typos or minor issues have been fixed. Hopefully this makes the experience a lot smoother.



[i]Until Next Time,[/i]
[i]Themisian.[/i]
